newsitem.title: POLAND: PLI to issue 3.5 mln rights.
newsitem.headline: PLI to issue 3.5 mln rights.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish wholesaler and retailer PLI SA will vote at an extraordinary meeting on February 11 on whether to issue 3,525,607 new shares at five zlotys each, the company said in a statement late on Friday.
The shares will be issued as part of a one-for-two rights issue, the statement said.
PLI, whose shares closed at 13.1 zlotys on Friday on the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse, currently has 7,051,213 shares outstanding.
Last month the company's shareholders rejected management's proposal to to issue between one million and 3.5 million shares to be offered to selected institutional long-term investors.
